voices.name: l00
voices.text: As an unknown actor, Jim Carrey <#0.2#> reportedly imagined his success at night.
voices.caption: As an unknown actor, Jim Carrey reportedly imagined his success at night.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Then he wrote himself <#0.2#> a ten million dollar check.
voices.caption: Then he wrote himself a ten million dollar check.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Dated years ahead. <#0.3#> He kept it in his wallet.
voices.caption: Dated years ahead. He kept it in his wallet.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Around that date, <#0.2#> he learned he'd be paid ten million for a movie.
voices.caption: Around that date, he learned he'd be paid ten million for a movie.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: But he says, <#0.2#> you can't just visualize and go eat a sandwich.
voices.caption: But he says, you can't just visualize and go eat a sandwich.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Imagine joyfully, <#0.2#> then live today well.
voices.caption: Imagine joyfully, then live today well.
